post.topic: Lost leads from missed client messages
post.headline: *Stop* losing leads on WhatsApp
post.subline: Auto‑reply and route every inquiry instantly to your CRM.
post.caption:
🚨 Missed a client message? It could cost you a project. 
Freelancers lose up to 30% of leads because they can’t reply fast enough. 
Fix: Deploy a WhatsApp AI bot that instantly acknowledges, qualifies, and pushes contacts to your CRM. 
Tip: Use a simple “Hi, I’m [Your Name]. What can I help you with today?” auto‑reply and set a keyword trigger to tag hot leads. 
Save this post and share it with a fellow consultant who needs faster replies. DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15‑min call
post.insight_note: Freelancers often juggle many chats, making fast response a critical competitive edge.
